Name: Sprint
Author: unidarkshin
Description:
[size=6][b][u][center]Sprint[/center][/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]Configurable settings are generated after the first game run. Please load a save to generate the config file. It is located at: [color=#fff2cc]Stardew Valley/Mods/Sprint/Data/<your save game>.json:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#fff2cc]Sprint Speed Increase:[/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][color=#ffe599]The amount of extra speed your character gains when sprinting. (Default: 2)[/color]
[*]Stamina Loss Per Half Second: [color=#ffe599]The amount of stamina you lose every 0.5 seconds. (Default: 1.0)[/color]
[*]Sprint Key: [color=#ffe599]The key you wish to hold to start sprinting. (Default: LeftControl) (Go to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Available_bindings]KEY BINDINGS [/url]﻿for available keys.)[/color]
[/list][/size]
